description: Defines the MessageMapper interface for mapping ExternalMessage objects to Adaptable objects and vice versa, including configuration, content-type handling, and conditions.

classes.name: MessageMapper
classes.description: Interface for mapping ExternalMessage to Adaptable and vice versa, with configuration and content-type handling.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns a unique identifier for the mapper.

methods.name: getContentTypeBlocklist
methods.description: Returns a collection of content types that the mapper should not handle.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the mapper with provided configuration objects.

methods.name: map (ExternalMessage)
methods.description: Maps an ExternalMessage to a list of Adaptable objects.

methods.name: map (Adaptable)
methods.description: Maps an Adaptable to a list of ExternalMessage objects.

methods.name: getDefaultOptions
methods.description: Returns default options as a JsonObject.

methods.name: getIncomingConditions
methods.description: Returns conditions for incoming message mapping.

methods.name: getOutgoingConditions
methods.description: Returns conditions for outgoing message mapping.

methods.name: findContentType (ExternalMessage)
methods.description: Finds the content-type header in an ExternalMessage.

methods.name: findContentType (Adaptable)
methods.description: Finds the content-type header in an Adaptable.
